title: The in-player suites of Prying Eyes
description: One entry for each check that runs inside the built player. It is written by hand and kept true by tools/test_player_tests.py; it runs nothing and replaces nothing in the game. See docs/engineering/agent-tooling.md.

unlisted.description: Test files that install themselves at load and are the source of no suite, each with the reason why.

name.description: What a runner will call it: the flag without its dash (traptest), or coop-<scenario> for the scenarios of tools/coop/run_all.ps1.

source.description: The C# file of the game that implements the check or reads its flag, from the repository root.

args.description: The whole command line after the executable, as a runner should issue it. Absent when a runner script owns the arguments.

mode.description: Which game the flags select: tower (the default of an automated run), catacombs (-catacombe), cathedral (-cattedrale, -cattedraletest), desert (-deserto, -desertotest), city (-citytest), track (-pista, -pistatest), or menu (no -autotest: the menus).

timeout.description: Seconds after which a runner gives up: an upper bound taken from the prose and the scripts, not a measurement.

checks.description: How many checks the suite ran when it was last confirmed by a run. Leave it out until a run has confirmed it.

needs.description: runtime: a built player. gpu: the run draws (no -nographics), so it needs a graphics card and nobody playing.

hazards.description: registry: writes the settings key that the maintainer's game reads. screen: opens a window or takes a monitor.

photos.description: The optional run that takes pictures: the flags to add (the run draws, so -nographics goes), what it needs and where the pictures land.

runner.description: For suites made of several processes: the script that starts them, and the parameters it is given.

page.description: The page that says what the suite proves.
